population_served_detail.notes: EMAS 2025 Tab.4.1/4.2 = angeschlossene Einwohner 2024; GB 2025 = pop. estatística Berlim 3,914 Mio em 2025 (Amt für Statistik).

water_loss_method: PRIMARY official KPI = Infrastructure Leakage Index (ILI) per DVGW/IWA: ILI 2024=0.92, 2023=0.86, 2022=0.81 (target <1.5). Volume ratio used for water_loss_pct: Leitungsverluste Rohrnetz 1,934,860 m3 / Reinwasserverteilung 222.4e6 m3 = 0.87% (EMAS 2025). Verbal claims differ (BWB press 2021 ~2%; ZFK interview with BWB ~3%) — not used as primary. Also Rohrschadensquote 0.07/km/a (2023) and 0.06 (EMAS status 2024 vs DVGW low threshold 0.1).

digital_assets.scada_leitsystem: 3 Leitwarten (Friedrichshagen, Tegel, Beelitzhof); GE iFix SCADA modernization + ACRON historian (Segno report); EMAS mentions Leitsystem LISA for sewer; online transfer of key metering points
digital_assets.ami_smart_meters: 2024: 32,946 digital meters of 280,785 water meters (99.6% metering coverage); target 100% digital house meters by 2031 (EMAS Tab.13)
digital_assets.semaplus_ai: SEMAplus ML sewer condition/strategy simulators in operational use at BWB since 2019 (KWB)
digital_assets.leak_detection: Acoustic zone monitoring (AZ/Hydrophon loggers) + correlation; network sweep ~every 5–6 years (BWB 2021 press)
digital_assets.cco: No public asset branded as 'CCO'; operations via Leitwarten / Leitsystem
digital_assets.digital_twin: No official BWB GB/EMAS claim of city-wide digital twin; hydraulic models + SEMAplus + SCADA exist

quality_and_treatment_notes.drinking_water: Jahresmedianwerte 2025 for 9 waterworks published; complies with TrinkwV (BWB analysewerte PDF). No routine disinfection in normal operation (groundwater protection).
quality_and_treatment_notes.wastewater_removal: BWB states ~97% retention of unsettled + biodegradable dissolved pollutants; N typically 85–88%, P >90% (BWB interview). Fourth-stage flocculation filtration / ozonation rollout ongoing.
quality_and_treatment_notes.sewer_connection: Public sewer connection rate Berlin >99.8% (Abgeordnetenhaus answers).

climate_context.source_mix: ~60% Uferfiltrat, ~30% precipitation recharge, ~10% artificial groundwater recharge (EMAS/Wasserkreislauf)
climate_context.spree_dependency: Lausitz lignite phase-out → lower Spree flow; ~70% of drinking water influenced by treated wastewater via bank filtrate/recharge (BWB 28580)
climate_context.stormwater: Combined sewer ~1/4 of city (inner S-Bahn ring); sponge city (Schwammstadt); CSO risk to Spree/Havel
